21_session_mechanics.five_fifo_roundtrips: order-count is mechanically schedulable in 21 sessions with 1-5 session lots if five actual buy/sell pairs fill; OHLC data cannot establish such fills or positive payoff

benchmark_reference.quality: unique date-only rows with positive closes; no intraday timestamp, source-revision metadata or scoring-feed identity embedded in this CSV
benchmark_reference.type: TradeSim-history SET50 daily index series; evidence supports use as a regime/benchmark research proxy only, exact organizer-scored feed/revision policy unconfirmed

limitations: Overlapping windows are not independent observations.
This is a retrospective feasibility baseline, not a signal study or promotion candidate.
Random baskets use only membership known for the entry date; outcome windows with missing future prices are censored and counted.
No authentic tick/IOC execution, liquidity constraint, or slippage calibration is represented.
The exact organizer scoring benchmark remains unconfirmed.
